snippet.title: Batman Returns (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Konami, Jan 1993 (Original Hardware, Composite)
snippet.description:
Batman Returns was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in January 1993. All audio/visual elements copyright 1993, Konami. Music composed by Otsumami Matsuo, Takashi Tateishi.

https://nesguide.com/games/batman-returns/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT BATMAN RETURNS (NES)

The game took the player through seven scenes featured in the film. Various henchmen with a clown-like appearance attack Batman throughout the game. Batman has a number of weapons and moves at his disposal, including a standard punch, and the batarang. Each level would end with a boss character, which would require a little more effort to defeat.
